source_quality_filter: web rows with 0<z<3 and matterDens>-90; growth rows from SDSS final BAO/RSD table only
web_mapping_rule: assign nearest predeclared z-bin; use median matterDens per z-bin; robust-normalize using source-only 10th/90th percentiles
normalization_rule: clip W_web to [0,1] using source-only quantiles
notes: This transform creates a growth-side source-native W_web design matrix only. It does not score an endpoint.
